_comment: Maps a captured baseline (by its file name, without the -<project> theme suffix) to its published paths under the docs img tree. sync-docs-images.mjs copies the `light` and `dark` baselines to those destinations. Paths are relative to docs-site/. Guides reference them as img/<file> through the reuse-image-light / reuse-image-dark shortcodes. Keep the $note current: it is what makes a stale capture traceable to the page it serves.
